question.prompt: How many pairs of positive integer solutions does the linear equation in two variables \(x+2y=7\) have?

solutions.explanation: When \(y=1\), \(x=5\); when \(y=2\), \(x=3\); when \(y=3\), \(x=1\). When \(y\ge4\), \(x\le-1\), which is not a positive integer. Therefore, there are 3 pairs.
solutions.title: Exhaust the positive integer cases
